  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "[Take cooked] {{ing_01|MALLOWS}}, {{ing_02|LEEKS}}, {{ing_03|BEETS}}, OR COOKED {{ing_04|CABBAGE SPROUTS}} [shoots or tender strunks] {{ing_05|THRUSHES}} [roast] AND {{ing_06|QUENELLES OF CHICKEN}}, {{ing_07|TIDBITS OF PORK OR SQUAB CHICKEN AND OTHER SIMILAR SHREDS OF FINE MEATS}} THAT MAY BE AVAILABLE."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "ARRANGE EVERYTHING ALTERNATELY IN LAYERS [in a mould or in a casserole]."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "CRUSH {{ing_08|PEPPER}} AND {{ing_09|LOVAGE}} WITH {{ing_10|2 PARTS OF OLD WINE}}, {{ing_11|1 PART BROTH}}, {{ing_12|1 PART HONEY}} AND {{ing_13|A LITTLE OIL}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "TASTE IT; AND WHEN WELL MIXED AND IN DUE PROPORTIONS PUT IN A SAUCE PAN AND ALLOW TO HEAT MODERATELY."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "WHEN BOILING ADD {{ing_14|A PINT OF MILK}} IN WHICH [about eight] {{ing_15|EGGS}} HAVE BEEN DISSOLVED."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "[next] POUR [this spiced custard] OVER [the layers of vegetables and meats, heat slowly without allowing to boil]."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "AND WHEN CONGEALED SERVE [either in the casserole, or carefully unmould the dish on a service platter]."
    }
  ],
